summary: Ran `ng update @angular/core@11 @angular/cli@11 --allow-dirty --force` from EFNgApp/EFNgApp/ClientApp (NG_DISABLE_VERSION_CHECK=1, via the already-installed local CLI since npx -p @angular/cli@11 failed to resolve the `ng` binary in this npm 6/Node 12 environment). The update bumped the Angular packages to 11.2.14, the CLI toolchain to 11.2.19, karma to 6.4.4, codelyzer to ^6.0.0, and ran Angular's own migrations: removed the deprecated `extractCss` option from angular.json, added an explicit `relativeLinkResolution: 'legacy'` to the root RouterModule.forRoot call to preserve pre-v11 routing behaviour, and renamed the deprecated `async` testing helper to `waitForAsync` in three spec files. No related third-party packages required a version bump for this hop (none detected; ngrx/nguniversal/codelyzer peer-dependency warnings against @angular/core remain and are unchanged from prior hops). Install and build pass; the test command fails the same pre-existing way as baseline (karma's test target still points at a nonexistent root-level `styles.css` instead of `src/styles.css`), so no new regression was introduced.
changes: Upgraded karma from ~5.0.0 to ~6.4.4, codelyzer from ^5.1.2 to ^6.0.0, @types/jasmine from ~3.3.9 to ~3.6.0, jasmine-core from ~3.5.0 to ~3.6.0
Angular CLI migration: removed the deprecated 'extractCss' option from angular.json's build and production configurations
Angular core migration: added relativeLinkResolution: 'legacy' to the root RouterModule.forRoot() call in src/app/app.module.ts to preserve existing routing behaviour under the new default
Angular core migration: renamed the deprecated 'async' testing helper to 'waitForAsync' in add-employee.component.spec.ts, counter.component.spec.ts, and fetch-employee.component.spec.ts

Angular core migrations for AbstractControl.parent nullability, ViewEncapsulation.Native removal, NavigationExtras omissions, and canActivate/redirectTo found nothing in this codebase that needed changing
package-lock.json regenerated by npm as part of `ng update`
manual_followups: npm install still prints peer-dependency warnings for @ngrx/* (^8.5.2), @nguniversal/module-map-ngfactory-loader@7.1.0 and codelyzer@6.0.2, which declare peers on @angular/core@^8 (or ^7, or <10.0.0); this hop's detection again found no required bump for them, but they should be moved to Angular-11-compatible majors in a later hop.

`npx -p @angular/cli@11 ng ...` failed to resolve the `ng` binary in this environment (npx: command not found: cli) on this npm 6/Node 12 setup; worked around by running the already-installed local @angular/cli (after `npm install`) directly via `npx ng update ...`. Later hops on this same Node version may need the same workaround.

The optional node-sass@4.11.0 dependency still fails to build its native binding on this Node 12 environment (missing python2 / no prebuilt binary for this ABI), same as at baseline; it does not fail npm install because it's an optionalDependency.

`npm run test` fails before any spec executes because angular.json's test architect target references `styles.css` at the ClientApp root instead of `src/styles.css`; this predates this hop (present in the baseline angular.json) and was left as-is per the rule that pre-existing failures don't need fixing.
